criterion.quoted:
## D.7 MAX scheduler measured policy

Historical Qwen concurrency measurements are priors, not constants. Recalibrate when model/runtime/machine/context changes.
```text
Scheduler observes:
    model identity
    runtime identity
    machine identity
    model/provider health
    ready-work shape
    context demand
    KV/slot cost
    critical path
    verifier backlog
    mutation contention
    I/O pressure
    GPU benchmark contamination
    background acquisition
    measured marginal throughput

Scheduler must never manufacture filler work solely to hit a concurrency number.
```
